name: Slackwater Pizzeria (Sandy / Draper Border) Rotisserie Chicken, Provolone & Olive Oil Flatbread Pizza
brandOrRestaurant: Slackwater Pizzeria & Pub (Sandy / Draper / Ogden, UT)
whyItWorks: Minutes from TownePlace Suites Draper, Slackwater's thin artisan crust (or gluten-free crust) brushed with olive oil, shredded chicken, and light mozzarella/parmesan avoids acidic red marinara sauce.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a custom Olive Oil base pizza with grilled chicken and light cheese (hold raw red onions, jalapeños, balsamic glaze, and spicy sausage) and take a lactase enzyme.
watchOuts: Avoid spicy honey/red-pepper pizzas and take lactase for the mozzarella cheese
